# book_timeslot (Resource)

The timeslot records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `name` (String) Display name of the timeslot.
- `owner_id` (String) Organisation that owns the timeslot.
- `schedule` (Dynamic) Recurrence pattern that defines when the timeslot applies.

### Optional

- `conditions` (Dynamic) Conditions that gate when the timeslot applies.
- `description` (String) Free form notes about the timeslot.
